page.overview:
Who is Alogar Fang?

is the oldest son of Thaisha Lloy and Halandil Fang.

Alogar is an orcish warrior. He is 27 years old as of the beginning of Campaign Four. Nov 2025|47:43}}

According to Sir Julien he is smart and skilled with weapons, and has great intuition. He is also very sociable and loves to drink with other soldiers in the Barrowguard.

When Alogar was still a child he climbed a ginkgo tree but fell and broke his neck; his mother reached him, feeling his death and using druidic magic for the first time to cast Spare the Dying, saving him just in time.
